value.rationale: Optimal distance-label partitions have a natural class-transfer reconfiguration question not settled by partition dimension. The full 7040-state graph is connected despite its nonregular local move spectrum; 34500 edges, radius seven, diameter eight and the exact shape distribution quantify attainable mobility for all optima of a canonical cubic graph. These precise structural quantities are not implied by scalar pd=4.
